snippet.title: The Secret of Weepstone | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
In the shadow of an abandoned keep lies the all-but-forgotten village of Weepstone. Once a thriving settlement, its fields now stand barren, its people desperate. Lord Byron has taken ill, his dreams plagued with visions of unholy rituals and occult symbols.

The Secret of Weepstone is a black-and-white, dungeon-crawling love letter to old-school role-playing games. Build your party of unlikely commonfolk from common villagers to battle-worn adventurers, and explore the keep to discover the mysterious source of Byron's suffering. There are no heroes here. Depending on your dice rolls, you may triumph and level up, or perish ignominiously, leaving the rest of your party with unique mortal favors to help the survivors brave the depths. Will you be able to unpick Weepstone’s Keep’s dangerous puzzles and secrets, or will your story end there, just like countless other adventurers?
